videos.desc: A farmyard on a misty morning. A young woman with a long blond braid, a denim shirt, orange dungarees and yellow rubber boots walks away across the wet concrete carrying two metal buckets of milk, which splash onto the ground as she turns and smiles. A line of black-and-white cows walks beside her towards a metal shed, where a farmer in green overalls stands at the open door. A collie trots past milk churns, and a steel milk tank and milking stalls stand by the shed, with green fields behind.

A farm lane on a misty morning. A young woman with a long blond braid, a denim shirt, orange dungarees and yellow rubber boots walks towards the camera laughing, letting go of a metal gate as a long line of black-and-white cows follows her out past a barn. She pats a cow on the back as it walks by her. A black-and-white collie trots behind, milk churns stand against the barn wall, a milk tanker is parked further back and a young man in green overalls walks along the fence of a green field.

Inside a village bakery at golden hour. A female deer with no antlers stands on the checked tiled floor and bites a croissant from a tray held by a surprised young woman baker in a white apron, a headscarf and an oven glove, then reaches for more. A paper bag of bread rolls has spilled on the floor, and floury hoof prints lead in from the open door. Glass counters of pastries and shelves of loaves fill the shop, an older woman peeks from the back and a cyclist outside takes a picture with his phone.

At a fountain in an old town square in autumn, a male mallard duck with a glossy green head, a white neck ring and orange feet flies in with its wings spread wide and lands on the arm of a white stone statue of a man in a robe. It folds its wings and sits there, looking around. A brown female duck swims in the water below, another green-headed male floats on the right, water spouts from carved stone fish, pigeons walk on the paving, and a church tower and a bakery stand behind.

Inside a white seaside restaurant with blue shutters, a young man in sunglasses, a white shirt and a black apron swings a red tablecloth like a bullfighter's cape and chases a group of goats out through the open glass doors. The goats run outside one after another until only one is left by the door. An overturned chair, plates, bread rolls and lemons lie on the terracotta floor, guests laugh and point by the window, a waitress holds up a tray, and the blue sea shines outside.

A wet golden retriever trots out of the shallow waves on a grey sandy beach on an overcast day, dragging a big pink inflatable flamingo by its head in its mouth. A laughing young woman with wet hair, a cream knitted jumper and a black swimsuit waits at the water's edge with her arms spread wide. The dog brings the flamingo up to her, she crouches down, and she hugs the dog while the flamingo lies on the sand beside them. Small waves roll in behind.

A smiling young woman with a long braid and a green wax jacket stands in a shallow stream in a misty wood at dusk, lit by an old oil lantern hanging from a twisted, mossy tree root. Holding the root with one hand, she searches in the water with the other, then pulls out a small dark lump and shows it, laughing, to a big shaggy grey dog beside her. Two scruffy terrier dogs watch from the bank, a canvas bag and a small trowel rest on a mossy stump, and autumn leaves float on the water.

On a stormy night at an animal rescue camp on the savanna, a young man in an olive ranger uniform stands behind a baby elephant lying on straw under a checked blanket. He lifts a large green tarpaulin higher with both arms to shield the calf, then looks down at it and smiles. Behind him, under a tin roof, other rangers with a lantern look after more young elephants. Lightning flashes near a lone acacia tree under dark clouds and the muddy ground is wet.

On a quiet village street at misty sunrise, a large adult male red deer with wide branching antlers stands on a zebra crossing, raises his head and calls out, his breath steaming in the cold air. He then lowers his head, looks around and steps forward across the crossing. Several female deer wait further down the street behind him. A black bird flies past a bakery with a striped awning, a van waits with its headlights on beside a striped post with an orange globe lamp, and a church spire rises behind.

At a wildlife park on a sunny day, a young woman with long braids, in a yellow sundress, leans forward on a wooden viewing deck and stretches her arm out, holding out a leafy branch to a tall giraffe, which sticks out its long dark tongue to reach it. She then pulls back laughing, and a guide in a khaki uniform and cap holds out another branch as the giraffe lifts its head. Smiling friends watch behind her, a potted plant stands on the deck and another giraffe walks on the dry sandy ground beyond the fence.

In a reed nest above a calm pond at sunset, a big grey fluffy cuckoo chick fills the whole nest and opens its wide orange beak. A much smaller brown reed warbler perched on a reed stem pushes a green caterpillar into its beak, then sits back and watches as the chick stretches up, flaps its wings and begs for more. A second small warbler waits nearby. Dragonflies hover over the water, a water bird swims behind and willow trees glow in the warm evening light.

On a windy heather moor under a cloudy sky, a young woman with a long braid, in a red jacket and dark trousers, runs with one shoe off, reaching after a red round flying device with a small box hanging under it, while a black and white sheepdog races beside her. A startled grouse flaps away from her feet. The device rises out of reach, and she jumps and stretches her arms up after it as the dog leaps too. A lost boot, a hat and a map lie in the heather, and a man on a quad bike watches from a dirt track.

The African savanna in warm evening light. A woman in an olive ranger shirt and bucket hat kneels in dry golden grass and holds a long curved elephant tusk of cream-white ivory across her arms. She looks at it closely and runs her hand along its finely cracked surface; its wide end is hollow. Behind her a man in the same uniform loads a metal box into an open safari truck, and in the dusty distance a herd of elephants walks past flat-topped acacia trees.

An autumn picnic in strong wind. A blue jay with a pointed blue crest, blue-and-white barred wings and a black collar stands on a glazed doughnut on a paper plate on a wooden picnic table, beak wide open as if it is screeching. Paper plates and a red checked blanket blow off the table, orange leaves swirl and another jay flies past in the sky. A cut cake with blue icing sits at the end of the table. A row of grey squirrels sits on the bench, seen from behind, staring up at the bird, and one climbs onto the table.

A steep whitewashed lane in a Greek island village at sunset. A grey female donkey wearing a woven straw hat and a folded blanket over her back stands on the stone steps, and her small fuzzy brown foal drinks milk from under her belly. The foal then steps forward and nuzzles its mother's side. Blue doors and shutters line the white houses, a tabby cat lies on a windowsill, pots of basil and a basket of lemons sit by a doorstep and a bucket of water stands on the ground. Pink bougainvillea hangs over a wall and the blue sea shines below.

On a narrow village street at sunrise, a young woman with a long red braid, in a waxed jacket, jeans and green wellington boots, walks towards the viewer swinging a metal bucket and leading a crowd of farm animals down the wet road: black and white cows, pink pigs, sheep, goats, white geese and brown hens, with breath steaming in the cold. Parked cars and a milk van stand behind them, and people watch from the doorways of grey stone houses, one of them waving.

In a farmhouse kitchen, a shaggy ginger Highland cow pushes its big head in over the lower half of a stable door and sticks out its pink tongue towards a young woman with a messy bun, in a cream cable-knit jumper, sitting at a wooden table. She turns her head sharply away with her eyes screwed shut, laughing, and holds up one hand to block the cow, while the cow keeps reaching for her with its tongue. Spilled oats lie on the table next to an enamel jug, and pots hang on the wall behind.

Close up under the white wooden eave of an old building, small birds with glossy dark blue backs, white bellies, long pointed wings and forked tails fly around a cup-shaped mud nest. One bird hovers in front of the nest with an insect in its beak, lands at the nest and pushes its head inside, then flies off again, while other birds swoop past. A few loose white feathers drift in the air, the light is soft and golden, and a blurred field lies in the background.

A cosy living room in the evening. A young woman with dark curly hair in a cream knit sweater leans close to a lit aquarium and purses her lips like a fish. A black fish with a large sail-like fin and tail swims up to the glass until it is face to face with her. Smaller silver-white fish swim among green plants and driftwood, and food flakes float at the surface. A fish net and a tub of fish food lie on the cabinet, and a cat sleeps on the sofa behind her.

Bright blue sea under water. A young woman in a black wetsuit, mask and long black fins swims forward through a clear tunnel that opens in the middle of a huge swirling school of small silver fish. Dolphins and sea lions glide along the edges of the shoal and cross the tunnel near her, trails of bubbles rise towards the surface, and the hull of a small boat floats on the sunlit surface high above. Rays of light shine down through the water.

On a snowy Arctic plain at golden hour, a big white polar bear stands up on its hind legs beside a large white tundra bus with huge tyres and rests its front paws on the side under a window. Inside, a young woman in a cream knitted hat presses her hands to the glass and gasps. The bear drops down onto all four paws and walks along the bus through the snow. Other passengers look out of the windows, one covering her mouth, and a second polar bear stands in the snow in the distance.

A herd of horses runs through a shallow river in a red desert canyon. At the front a laughing young woman with a long black braid, in a denim shirt and jeans, rides barefoot and bareback on a buckskin horse straight towards the front, water splashing up around its legs. Dozens of brown, grey and white horses gallop behind her, kicking up dust and water in the golden evening light. People stand at a wooden corral fence in the background under a huge sandstone rock.

In a sunny old country kitchen, a plump tabby cat with a white chest and a brown leather collar with a small bell lies stretched out on a peeling white windowsill with one front paw hanging over the edge. The cat gets up, walks along the sill past a green potted plant and sits upright, looking out of the window. Tea towels and a jar of wooden spoons hang behind it, and a basket of onions, a ball of grey wool and a saucer of milk sit on the stone floor by a wooden table.

On a calm fjord, a young woman in a red jacket, a yellow life vest and a dark woolly hat sits in a white kayak holding a paddle and smiling. Right behind her, without warning, a huge humpback whale bursts up out of the water and crashes back down in a big white splash. She turns her head, her mouth falls open in shock, and then she laughs with wide eyes. Steep mountains covered in orange and yellow autumn trees rise behind, with a small red boathouse on the shore.

A wooden giraffe-feeding platform in the African countryside. The viewer's hands, in a linen shirt and a silver watch, hold out a green leafy twig, and a giraffe's head is only a few centimetres away, its long dark tongue stretching out to the leaves, every hair and spot clearly visible. The giraffe pulls the twig into its mouth and chews, looking straight ahead. A young woman in a rust top leans on the railing beside it, laughing and pointing. Flat-topped trees stand under a cloudy sky.

A breakfast table in an old dining room with a black and white checked floor and a brass chandelier. An elephant pushes its head through the tall open window and stretches its long trunk further and further across the table, past a plate of croissants held by a laughing young woman in a lilac top, towards the banana in the viewer's hand. The viewer's other hand holds a cup of coffee on the white tablecloth, and potted palms stand by the walls.

An outdoor dinner in a stone courtyard at dusk, seen from the viewer's seat. The viewer twirls a big forkful of spaghetti in tomato sauce and lifts it high above a bowl on a blue checked tablecloth. A black, white and brown dog with its chin on the table edge raises its head, follows the food with wide eyes, licks its lips and keeps staring, waiting for a bite. Behind it stand an olive tree hung with warm string lights, lavender bushes, terracotta pots, a wooden chair and an old stone wall under a peach sky.

A tropical beach at sunrise with no people. A tiny baby sea turtle crawls across the smooth wet sand straight towards the sea on its own, flicking up little sprays of sand with its flippers and leaving a trail behind it, until a gentle wave washes over it at the water's edge. Behind it are the sandy hole of its nest with broken eggshells and a coconut husk, and a small pale crab scuttles nearby. Palm trees lean along the shore and the low golden sun casts long shadows.

A cosy bedroom with wooden walls, a paper lamp and a mustard bedspread. A brown hen sits on a pile of folded white towels in a wicker laundry basket on the bed. A young woman in a blue T-shirt lies on the bed with her cupped hands under the hen, catches a fresh brown egg and lifts it up, laughing in delight. In the doorway a young man in a navy sweater drops a laundry bag and stares with his mouth open, then grins. A clothes rail and framed plant prints are behind.

A small city park in spring, with pink blossom trees and blocks of flats behind. A young woman in a lilac jacket hurries past, clutching her tiny dog to her chest and staring back with a worried face, and leaves the view. Behind her a large black and tan rottweiler lies calmly on the grass with a small grey kitten standing on its head, while a smiling young woman in a yellow hoodie crouches beside it and strokes it. A man in a navy T-shirt holds a small terrier on a lead.

A park path on a sunny autumn day, with a lake, ducks and a black lamp post. A young woman with a huge mass of curly light-brown hair, in a rust jumper and black leggings, jogs along the path. Right beside her an apricot poodle with exactly the same fluffy curly hair walks along a green bench on its back legs, its mouth open like hers. Behind them a young woman in a green jacket and a young man in a tan jacket laugh and point at the pair.

Inside a dim aquarium with concrete walls. A huge curved glass tank of blue water rises on the left, and a large sea turtle swims slowly past, right up close to the glass, moving its flippers. A young woman in a blue jumper and white trousers presses her hand flat against the thick glass wall, and a young man in a rust T-shirt stands beside her with his hand on the glass too, both smiling and laughing. The glass stands between them and the turtle, and a metal rail runs along the tank.

A gravel path across a university lawn at sunset, with red brick buildings covered in ivy behind. A large goose stands on the path with its wings spread wide and its neck stretched out. A young woman in a maroon sports top and shorts leaps sideways off the path onto the grass, laughing, to keep clear of it, and runs off. A young man on a bicycle rides past the goose, and a young man and woman holding coffee cups stand still and watch from a distance. The goose then folds its wings.

A sunny back garden with a white picket fence, a blossoming tree and a small blue kennel. A young woman with long black hair in a yellow cardigan and jeans kneels on the grass, holding a golden puppy in one hand and a black puppy in the other, looking from side to side with a thoughtful, undecided face. She lifts both puppies up and smiles. A tennis ball and rope toys lie on the lawn. Behind her a young woman in a green T-shirt pours a bucket of water into a blue paddling pool.

A smiling young man in an olive fleece stands inside a snowy zoo enclosure with three snow leopards. He holds a metal bucket high while one leopard stands on its hind legs and leans against his chest, another rolls on its back on the gravel and a third walks along a rocky ledge above. The standing leopard drops onto all fours, the man lowers the bucket and the leopard pushes its nose into it. Pieces of meat lie on the ground, and a large crowd of visitors watches from behind a glass wall.
